aliases: professional agile leadership i pal i
exam_rules: Open-book, not proctored. Taken directly on scrum.org. One browser tab only recommended. No time banking — timer runs continuously. No formal expiry on certifications.
id_requirements: No ID required for online assessments. Email address and scrum.org account required.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-19: Scrum.org's PAL I certification page is live: 'The Professional Agile Leadership™ (PAL I) certification validates that you are a leader who understands the value Agile can bring to a business and how to actively practice Agile.' with 'Certification Details $200 USD per attempt Passing score: 85% Time limit: 60 minutes Number of Questions: 36' and Buy Now.
